title: Coverlet Collector
description: Collect code coverage data in .NET with Coverlet.

data.text: **Coverlet** is a cross-platform code coverage framework for .NET. It integrates with `dotnet test` and supports multiple output formats.

data.title: Run Tests with Coverage
data.content:
dotnet test /p:CollectCoverage=true /p:CoverletOutputFormat=opencover

# Generate HTML report
dotnet reportgenerator "-reports:coverage.opencover.xml" "-targetdir:coverage-report" -reporttypes:Html

data.title: Coverlet Output Formats
items: cobertura – Used by many CI systems

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Combine with ReportGenerator for HTML reports
data.takeaway: Add Coverlet to your CI pipeline to track coverage trends.
